description-proc.eng: Background The contracting authority needs to renew the vehicle fleet for personnel who work with housing inspections and sweeping. The procurement will be carried out as a result of new requirements for division into a clean and dirty zone in the vehicles. The aim is to facilitate a safer and more appropriate work day, including reducing exposure to degassing, dust and other pollution from equipment and work clothes used in the service. The vehicles shall be used in daily operative operations and must support safe transport of personnel, tools, sweeping equipment and polluted equipment. Therefore there is a need for vehicles and fittings solutions that together provide good functionality, practical access, satisfactory ergonomics and reliable handling of equipment in accordance with the business ́s needs. The budget limit for the procurement is estimated to be between NOK 6,300,000 excluding VAT and NOK 7,800,000 excluding VAT, depending on the sale of existing vehicles. Reservations related to the price, including currency reservations, shall be clearly and unambiguously stated and priced. Conditions that are not priced or that lead to uncertainty in the evaluation can lead to rejection, cf. the Public Procurement Regulations § 24-8. Vehicles with characteristics are requested that make them suitable for daily service use, including good capacity, sufficient payload with full furnishing and accessibility suitable for varied operational conditions. The furnishing system shall be functional for handling and separating clean and polluted equipment, and at the same time support safe and ergonomical use in the everyday work. The procurement also includes fixtures that provide appropriate storage and practical access to equipment and work material. Further requirements for vehicles, fitting out, performance and delivery are in the requirement specifications. The stated volume is an estimate and the contracting authority can reduce or increase the scope within the stated procurement regulations. description-proc.eng: QQI is the Qualifications and Quality Assurance Authority of Ireland with responsibility for (among other things) - the external quality assurance of providers of further education (FET) and training or higher education (HE) (providers) in Ireland including designated, delegated and listed awarding bodies. - the external quality assurance of designated and listed awarding bodies that are not providers. - the provision of statutory guidelines on the quality assurance of education, training, research and related services. - determining national policies and criteria for access, transfer and progression in relation to learners (ATP), and monitoring the implementation of procedures for ATP by providers. - promoting, maintaining, further developing and implementing the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ), which is a system of levels and types for awards of qualifications based on standards of knowledge, skill or competence . - deciding which awards are included in the NFQ. - facilitating the recognition of qualifications inside and outside the state. title-proc.eng: Copenhagen - New Metroline, M5 Transportation System

description-proc.eng: This tender presents a substantial opportunity for prospective contractors to bid for the M5 Transportation System South package (TSS), a critical component of the Copenhagen metro system's expansion. This project is of significant strategic importance, as the M5 line is a fully automated driverless metro system that will not only enhance passenger service on existing metro corridors but is also planned to extend connectivity to emerging urban development areas, including Kløverparken, Refshaleøen, and Lynetteholm in the East Harbour. The M5 is to operate as an independent system, ensuring that its construction and subsequent operation do not disrupt the existing M1-M4 metro lines. The current tender, Phase 1, encompasses the southern section of the line, from København H to north of v/Prags Boulevard, with an anticipated operational commencement in 2036. The broader vision includes the northern section with an anticipated operatonal commencement of the last part of the northern section in 2045 (included in the transportation system contract (TSS-contract) as options) and a potential future extension to form a ring line, signifying a long-term commitment to urban mobility. The procurement comprises the following, together constituting a mixed procurement within the meaning of Article 5 (2) of the Utilities Directive: 1) A TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM for M5 south encompassing the subsystems rolling stock (passenger vehicles, service vehicles and rescue trolleys), railway infrastructure (signaling system and other subsystems, excluding permanent way and power supply "on the line"), and a CMC (control and maintenance center). Furthermore, O&M supplies (supplies related to the O&M providers operation and maintenance activities such as maintenance plans and training). “On the line” refers to deliveries outside the CMC (as the Transportation System Contractor (TSC) is itself responsible for power supply and permanent way within the CMC). The integration of the mentioned TS-subsystems and the integration of the scope of supply of the CWC into the Transportation System (including but not limited to permanent way and power supply on the line) is also part of the TSC's responsibilities and forms part of the TSS-contract. Rolling stock, railway Infrastructure and the CMC are further described in M5-2-TSS-SW (Scope of Work) of the tender documents. 2) MAINTENANCE SERVICES following hand over of the Transportation System related to the continued maintenance of the Transportation System (hereinafter Maintenance Services). The TSS-contract covers both the Transportation System and the Maintenance Services. The Maintenance Services are governed by a separate maintenance contract forming an attachment to the TSS-contract (hereinafter Maintenance Contract) The purchase of the Transportation System and the Maintenance Services should therefore be seen as a whole and only one Tenderer will be awarded the contracts. The expected scope and characteristics of the two contracts are described in the tender documents. 3) OPTIONS Three (3) options are included in the TSS-contract: Option 1: The purchase of up to 5 additional passenger vehicles. Option 2: The extension of the transportation system from Prags Boulevard to Refshaleøen. Option 3: The extension of the transportation system from Refshaleøen to Lynetteholm. Metroselskabet’s requirements relating to the Transportation System are set out in the tender documents, including the draft TSS-contract and the Scope of Works document (M5-2-TSS-SW). Requirements may be developed and changed during the competitive dialogue. As regards the Maintenance Contract, no draft contract or draft specifications are included in the tender documents at this stage. This reflects the fact that a central element of the competitive dialogue will be to explore the scope and structure of the Maintenance Contract, including the distribution of maintenance tasks between the TSCand the future operator of the Transportation System (hereinafter the OAMC). As a central element of the dialogue phase, Metroselskabet wishes to explore the advantages and implications of possible distributions of maintenance tasks between the TSC and the OAMC and the technical, commercial and legal terms that will be relevant depending on the maintenance model chosen. The potential models to be discussed and assessed during the dialogue phase are expected to span from a scope of the Maintenance Contract similar to TSSSA models (“Technical Support and Spares Supply Agreements”) to a scope similar to FSA models (“Full Service Agreements”) whereby the Metroselskabet would procure most goods, works and services needed for the maintenance and continued development of the Transportation System from the TSC. However, also models which are “in between” or a model where the scope will change over time may be chosen. Also the options to purchase additional passenger vehicles and options covering the extension of the line (northern section) are subject to dialogue. Both technical and commercial requirements are expected to be discussed including elements related to pricing. For further detailing of items planned to be subject for dialogue, reference is made to the Instructions to Tenderers (M5-0-TSS-ITT).

description-proc.eng: Göng&Brú is a new Icelandic State-owned infrastructure company established to finance, build, own, operate and maintain major transport infrastructure of national economic importance, constituted under the Act on Innvidafélag enacted by the Icelandic Parliament on 18 June 2026. It follows the model of comparable State-owned infrastructure companies in the Nordic region, including Sund & Bælt in Denmark and Iceland’s own experience with the Hvalfjörður tunnel. It will operate at arm’s length from the Government, on a commercial and self-sustaining basis. Göng&Brú’s initial portfolio represents a capital programme in excess of EUR 1.5 billion, encompassing the Sundabraut arterial route in Reykjavík, a second bore of the Hvalfjörður sub-sea tunnel, the forward financing of the new Ölfusárbrú bridge, and the Fljótagöng Tunnel, with further projects to follow under the 2026–2040 National Transportation Plan. Together these projects represent a multiyear capital programme of substantial scale. This notice is published as part of a Pre-Market Engagement (PME) exercise conducted prior to any formal procurement process. title-proc.eng: Market survey on alarm services for city officers

description-proc.eng: Introduction The Agency for Urban Environment invites the supplier market to a market dialogue regarding the provision of alarm services and the accompanying to uncover 1) the supplier market and potential tenderers, and 2) systems offered to cover the need for alarm functions for the company's urban city service officers. The objective of the market dialogue is to obtain information on the market's systems, technological possibilities, service models and best practice before any competition notice. The dialogue shall contribute to ensuring that a future procurement is designed in a way that safeguards the company's needs, at the same time as facilitating competition and innovation. This market dialogue is not a competition and a contract will not be signed as a result of this enquiry alone. About the Entity The Agency for Urban Environment needs alarm services that support city officers on foot, on bicycles and in vehicles. The service shall contribute to: * Effective handling of alarms and events * Quick notification and coordination of city officers * Documentation and traceability * Increased security for employees, visitors and values ·         Efficient interaction either between the alarm centre and operative resources or internally between operative resources. The organisation would like to gain better insight into available systems and future development trends within alarm management. Background The entity is considering to procure alarm services that can include: * Reception and management of technical alarms * Assault alarms/safety alarms * Notification to city officers and other stand-by resources * Logging and reporting * Notification to security guards and other stand-by resources * Integrations with existing security and access systems The company would like information on how such services are currently provided in the market. Contract models * Which pricing models are used? * How are alarm reception, call-outs and additional services priced? * Which contract forms are recommended? Provisional needs description The organisation would like a description of which systems can be offered in general, but will present a provisional description of requirements where the points below will be focused. Descriptions of other offered systems are also encouraged to include. ·         Mobility in alarm units/systems that can be offered. This includes a description of the weight, design and fasteners. ·         Robustness and weather resistance. Describe how the proposed systems will tolerate Nordic conditions with a focus on humidity/rain/water and cold conditions. The company also requests certifications, industry standards that can be requested for proposed systems. ·         Operational duration for the battery for proposed systems as well as time spent on charging. ·         Coverage area. Describe what degree of coverage can be expected from proposed systems. For this point, the company emphasises that the need is full coverage throughout Oslo - also in outer parts of Oslo and between high-level buildings in the centre of Oslo. ·         User friendliness and simplicity in use. The organisation will focus on simplicity when needed to trigger alarms and simplicity when receiving the alarm. Describe what happens when there is a need to trigger the alarm and what is being communicated to the person who receives the alarm for proposed systems. ·         Report functionality. Describe the possibility for reporting alarms with the accompanying information and how this is presented and can be analysed. ·         Privacy and information security. o How are privacy and information security safeguarded? o What certifications and standards are complied with? o How are data storage and access control handled? Emphasis is put on the fact that the needs description is provisional and can be changed after the completed market dialogue. Implementation of market dialogue The market dialogue is planned to be carried out in the following stages: Step 1 - Written input Tenderers will submit written responses to the questions in this document. Step 2 Summary The organisation will use the input for further needs clarification and any competition design. Practical information Deadline for input 19.08.2026 - 12:00 Submission: Answers shall be sent electronically through Artifik. All questions shall be sent electronically through Artifik. Confidentiality and the public. Received answers will be processed in accordance with the current regulations. Tenderers are requested to clearly mark any information that is seen as business secrets or other confidential information. The company reserves the right to publish general and anonymised summaries of the market dialogue. Reservations Participation in the market dialogue does not give any rights in connection with any later competition. The company will not be bound to hold a procurement as a result of this market dialogue. All costs connected to participation are to be borne by each tenderer. We look forward to receiving input and thank you for your interest.

title-proc.eng: 10019362-Appui à l'adaptation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de cacao en Côte d'Ivoire aux défis de durabilité

description-proc.eng: PRO PLANTEURS III builds on two previous five year phases (2015-2020, 2020-2025) that professionalized cocoa cooperatives and improved production systems in Côte d'Ivoire. To date, 47 cooperatives have strengthened management and services, helping raise average yields and farm incomes by about 30% among some 15,000 farms. Jointly with companies from the German Initiative on Sustainable Cocoa (GISCO) the project created seven village forest protection committees and 58 savings-groups and established 40 child-labor monitoring committees. Since 2024, 80 women have been implementing child labor prevention measures. Launched in 2025, the third phase is part of the Program entitled "Protection, Restoration and Sustainable Management of Forests and Biodiversity as Natural Life Support Systems in Côte d'Ivoire." The project is integrated into the program's landscape approach, balancing economic and ecological objectives. By promoting sustainable production practices, it helps curb the continued destruction of forest landscapes caused by cocoa cultivation and contributes to the program's overall aim of conserving biodiversity and forest landscapes. The project's objective is to adapt the cocoa supply chain in regions around the Bossématié reserve to economic, regulatory, environmental and social challenges. It emphasizes sustainable production aligned with the ARS 1000 standard and the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR), and control of the cocoa swollen shoot virus. Interventions aim to curb deforestation and increase farm resilience through diversification and yield improvements. Financing is provided by BMZ with co- financing from GISCO; parallel funding from the German Ministry of Agriculture (BMLEH) supports knowledge exchange. The national partner, the Conseil Café Cacao (CCC), contributes in kind and financially. The target group comprises 8,000 smallholder cocoa farms and their families and 12 cooperatives. Many farms face ageing orchards, high swollen shoot prevalence, inefficient practices and low productivity (~350 kg/ha), resulting in incomes far below a living income-particularly for women due to limited access to land, inputs, labor and decision making. Less than 20% of cooperatives are effective and transparent; services are narrow, networks are weak and bargaining power with buyers is limited. The project is organized in four components: 1. Good agricultural practices and agroforestry to raise yields/incomes and expand agroforestry areas in line with ARS 1000. 2. Demand oriented cooperative services to enable ARS 1000/EUDR compliance, prevent and control swollen shoot, and improve women's productivity. 3. Sustainable supply chain models that strengthen cooperative-buyer relationships (fair remuneration, timely payments, longer terms) and use incentives for environmental services and agroforestry. 4. Evidence based dialogue and knowledge exchange among supply chain actors, including an independent PRO PLANTEURS digital platform to disseminate lessons and support integration into policies, training and strategies. Geographic focus: Indénié Djuablin, La Mé and Sud Comoé regions.

description-proc.ell: Το έργο αφορά στην κατασκευή εγκαταστάσεων αντλιοστασίων για τη διασύνδεση της τηλεθέρμανσης Κοζάνης με τις νέες και υπό κατασκευή εγκαταστάσεις παραγωγής θερμικής ενέργειας εντός του γηπέδου ΑΗΣ Καρδίας μέσω του νέου υπό κατασκευή συστήματος μεταφοράς θερμικής ενέργειας, αποτελούμενο από αγωγούς ονομαστικής διαμέτρου DN700mm DN600mm DN450mm με φορέα θερμό /υπέρθερμο νερό. Αναλυτικότερα αφορά στην κατασκευή των ακολούθων διακριτών εγκαταστάσεων: Εγκαταστάσεις (αντλιοστασίων και λοιπού εξοπλισμού) διασύνδεσης σε γήπεδο που παραχωρήθηκε στη ΔΕΥΑΚ εντός του ΑΗΣ/ΔΕΗ Καρδιάς αναφερόμενες ως «ΑΝΤΛΙΟΣΤΑΣΙΟ ΚΑΡΔΙΑΣ». Στις εγκαταστάσεις που πρόκειται να υλοποιηθούν με το έργο περιλαμβάνεται ο ακόλουθος κύριος εξοπλισμός και εργασίες: Αντλιοστάσιο κυκλοφορίας θερμού νερού συστήματος μεταφοράς. Αντλιοστάσιο κυκλοφορίας θερμού νερού συστήματος παραγωγής Εναλλάκτες θερμότητας για τον υδραυλικό διαχωρισμό των υφιστάμενων συστημάτων μεταφοράς τηλεθέρμανσης ΔΕΥΑΚ και παραγωγής. Λοιπός βοηθητικός εξοπλισμός (ρύθμισης πίεσης και παραλαβής διαστολών, κατεργασίας και συμπλήρωσης νερού, φίλτρανσης, προσθήκης χημικών προσθέτων, ασφαλιστικές διατάξεις, μετρητές ενέργειας κλπ) Σύνδεση των νέων εγκαταστάσεων με τις υφιστάμενες ή νέες εγκαταστάσεις που πρόκειται να υλοποιηθούν (αγωγός μεταφοράς, εγκαταστάσεις παραγωγής) (ύδρευση, αποχέτευση, ισχυρά και ασθενή ρεύματα και λοιπές). Σύστημα αυτοματισμού ελέγχου και τηλεδιαχείρισης για την επιτήρηση του Αντλιοστασίου Καρδιάς από απόσταση. Το σύστημα θα συνεργάζεται πλήρως με το υφιστάμενο σύστημα ελέγχου/τηλεδιαχείρισης του κέντρου ελέγχου εγκαταστάσεων τηλεθέρμανσης και θα αποτελεί ουσιαστικά επέκταση αυτού. Εγκαταστάσεις-εργασίες μετασκευών στο υφιστάμενο αντλιοστάσιο τηλεθέρμανσης στην περιοχή Κασλά Κοζάνης (αντικατάσταση αντλητικών συγκροτημάτων αντλιοστασίου Α2 και λοιπού εξοπλισμού, ώστε το αντλιοστάσιο να ανταποκρίνεται στις απαιτήσεις του νέου συστήματος μεταφοράς καθώς και τροποποιήσεις όδευσης των αγωγών μεταφοράς εντός του οικοπέδου του αντλιοστασίου), στη συνέχεια αναφερόμενες ως «ΑΝΤΛΙΟΣΤΑΣΙΟ ΚΑΣΛΑ». Οι εργασίες αφορούν κυρίως σε Αντικατάσταση των κύριων αντλητικών συγκροτημάτων αντλιοστασίου Α2 με τις συνοδευτικές αυτών εργασίες Αντικατάσταση υφιστάμενων μετασχηματιστών με νέους για την κάλυψη των αυξημένων απαιτήσεων ηλεκτρικής ισχύος λόγω του νέου εξοπλισμού. Αντικατάσταση υφιστάμενων ρυθμιστών στροφών αντλητικών συγκροτημάτων αντλιοστασίου Α1. Τροποποίηση των οδεύσεων των προμονωμένων αγωγών του συστήματος μεταφοράς εντός του γηπέδου εγκαταστάσεων τηλεθέρμανσης. Επανασχεδιασμό του υφιστάμενου συστήματος αυτοματισμού λειτουργικού ελέγχου των κύριων αντλιοστασίων. Αναβάθμιση γραμμών τροφοδοσίας ισχυρών και ασθενών ρευμάτων των νέων αντλητικών συγκροτημάτων. Σύστημα αυτοματισμού ελέγχου και τηλεδιαχείρισης για την επιτήρηση του Αντλιοστασίου Καρδιάς από απόσταση (βλ. ανωτέρω-Αντλιοστάσιο Καρδιάς)καθώς και του βανοστασίου Δρεπάνου. Το σύστημα θα συνεργάζεται πλήρως με το υφιστάμενο σύστημα ελέγχου /τηλεδιαχείρισης του κέντρου ελέγχου εγκαταστάσεων τηλεθέρμανσης και θα αποτελεί ουσιαστικά επέκταση αυτού. Με την υλοποίηση των εγκαταστάσεων ονομαστική μεταφορική ισχύς του συστήματος θα είναι 195MWth.
description-proc.eng: The project concerns the construction of pumping station facilities for the interconnection of Kozani district heating with the new and under construction thermal energy production facilities within the Kardia Thermal Power Plant site through the new thermal energy transfer system under construction, consisting of pipes of nominal diameter DN700mm DN600mm DN450mm with hot/superheated water as the carrier. In detail, it concerns the construction of the following distinct facilities: Installations (pump stations and other equipment) for interconnection in a field granted to DEYAK within the Kardia Thermal Power Plant/PPC referred to as "KARDIAS PUMP STATION". The facilities to be implemented with the project include the following main equipment and works: Hot water circulation pumping station for the transport system. Hot water circulation pump station of the production system Heat exchangers for the hydraulic separation of the existing district heating transport systems DEYAK and production. Other auxiliary equipment (pressure regulation and expansion valve reception, water treatment and replenishment, filtration, addition of chemical additives, safety devices, energy meters, etc.) Connection of the new facilities with the existing or new facilities to be implemented (transport pipeline, production facilities) (water supply, sewage, strong and weak currents and others). Automation control and remote management system for the remote monitoring of the Kardias Pumping Station. The system will fully cooperate with the existing control/remote management system of the district heating facilities control center and will essentially be an extension of it. Installations-renovation works at the existing district heating pumping station in the Kasla area of Kozani (replacement of pumping units of pumping station A2 and other equipment, so that the pumping station meets the requirements of the new transmission system as well as modifications to the routing of the transmission pipelines within the pumping station site), hereinafter referred to as "KASLA PUMP STATION". The works mainly concern Replacement of the main pumping units of pumping station A2 with their accompanying works Replacement of existing transformers with new ones to cover the increased electrical power requirements due to the new equipment. Replacement of existing speed regulators of pumping units of pumping station A1. Modification of the routing of the pre-insulated pipelines of the transmission system within the district heating installation site. Redesign of the existing operational control automation system of the main pumping stations. Upgrading of the supply lines of strong and weak currents of the new pumping complexes. Control automation and remote management system for the remote monitoring of the Kardia Pumping Station (see above-Kardia Pumping Station) as well as the Drepano valve station. The system will fully cooperate with the existing control/remote management system of the district heating installation control center and will essentially be an extension of it. With the implementation of the installations, the nominal transmission capacity of the system will be 195MWth.
